name: Gritz N Wafflez
facts: Gritz N Wafflez is a woman-owned Texas Flava / Southern Hospitality spot in Koreatown, Los Angeles.
Address: 3183 Wilshire Blvd, Suite 185, Los Angeles, CA 90010.
Open daily, 9 AM to 3 PM.
The first 15 minutes of valet are complimentary.
GNW Karaoke is every Wednesday, 6 to 10 PM.
The game is called Order Up! It is free to play, and you don't need an account to play.
Each Order Up! level is 90 seconds, and 3 walk-outs close the kitchen.
Order Up! has Adult mode and Kid mode (12 and under), each with its own prizes and weekly board.
The weekly top score wins a Free Wingz N' Wafflez plus a karaoke shoutout. The board resets every Monday.
Adult prizes: 13,500 Free Kiki Palmer; 22,000 Free side of Smackin' Mac; 32,000 Free Fried Cheese Gritz; 46,500 Free Original Collard Green Dip.
Kid prizes: 9,500 Free Fresh Squeezed OJ; 11,000 Free side of French Friez; 12,750 Free Sweet Gritz; 13,250 Free Chocolate Chip Waffle.
The rewards ladder is 250 / 450 / 700 / 1,100 points.
The 250-point reward is a Free Kiki Palmer.
The 450-point reward is a Free side of Smackin' Mac.
The 700-point reward is a Free Original Collard Green Dip.
The 1,100-point reward is a Free N' Wafflez plate.
One free Daily Spin per member per day (Los Angeles time). Every slice wins something.
Game prizes must be used within 3 days. You can hold one prize at a time.
Kid mode needs a parent or guardian (18+) to sign in first.
Menu prices are on the online order page, not in this app.
No purchase is necessary to play, spin or win.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.

Original Collard Green Dip, Fried Green Tomatoes, Celestial Eggs (fried deviled eggs), Spicy Fried Pickles and Fried Cheese Gritz.

qa.q: What's the Original Collard Green Dip?
qa.a: It's like artichoke dip but better: creamy cheese mixed with al dente collard greens, served with homemade tortilla chips. It's our signature starter.
Deviled eggs, fried, and topped with Mama Zula's creole seasoning. A crowd favorite.

qa.q: What comes with the N' Gritz plates?
qa.a: They come with your choice of our signature gritz and sauce. Pick from Shrimp (six jumbo shrimp, sautéed or fried), Tenderz, Catfish, or Wingz (three jumbo wingz).

qa.q: What are the N' Wafflez plates?
qa.a: Wingz N' Wafflez (a fan fave), Tenderz N' Wafflez, Catfish N' Wafflez and Shrimp N' Wafflez. You can pick any waffle from the Just Wafflez list.

qa.q: What waffle flavors do you have?
qa.a: Peach Cobbler, Mixed Berry, Sweet Vanilla Bean, Cinnamon Roll, Chocolate Chip, Cheddar Herb and Bacon Cheddar.

A free wheel you can spin once a day as a member (Los Angeles time). Every slice wins something, and you never pay or use tokens to spin.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +50 points (30%), +100 points (20%), +75 points (15%), $2 off any plate (15%), Free Kiki Palmer (8%), Free side of Smackin' Mac (7%), or 10% off your order (5%).
Once per member per day, based on Los Angeles time.

qa.q: Do I have to buy anything to play or spin?
qa.a: No. No purchase is necessary to play Order Up!, spin the wheel or win a prize, and buying doesn't improve your chances.
It's our game where you work the line at Gritz N Wafflez. Build each guest's plate, serve it hot and deliver it to the right table, fast.
Yes, free to play as often as you like, with no account needed. You need a free member account only to save a score or claim a prize.

qa.q: How do I play Order Up!?
qa.a: Tap food tiles to build the plate, tap Serve 🛎️, then tap the hot plate on the pass and tap the guest's table. Faster means more points.
It's all taps. Tap food tiles to add them (tap again or ↩️ Undo to remove), tap Serve, tap the plate on the pass, then tap the table. Up to 4 plates can wait on the pass.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: The app supports game controllers, including Xbox, PlayStation and Switch Pro. Pair one, then press any button. Use A to tap what's highlighted.
Each level lasts 90 seconds. If 3 tables walk out, the kitchen closes and your run ends.
Levels 1 to 3 are just tap and serve. Level 4 puts you on the fryer. Level 5 is the whole kitchen. It keeps getting a bit tighter after that.

qa.q: How do I cook in levels 4 and 5?
qa.a: Level 4: fry catfish, wingz, tenderz and shrimp. Tap the tile, then tap the basket and pull it out on ✨ perfect. Level 5 adds waffle irons (open on 🟢) and the skillet for eggs, bacon and sautéed shrimp.

Speed is the big one, counted to 0.1 s from when the table sits down. You also score for heat, the order's pay, tips, each correct item (+30), a clean build with no undo (+40), streaks and clearing levels.

qa.q: Why does the heat of the plate matter?
qa.a: Plates cool on the pass: hot, warm, cooling, then cold ❄️. Cold food pays less and gets no tip.

qa.q: How do I get the big tip?
qa.a: Serve a perfect plate (no undo), hot, to the right table.
Perfect, fast plates in a row build a multiplier of ×1.2, ×1.4 and so on, up to ×2.

qa.q: What is the Whole Table bonus?
qa.a: Serve every plate at a table within 10 seconds of each other for +30 a guest.
Wrong plate −20, adding a NO item −60, wrong table −15 (the plate comes back colder), undercooked −30, charred −15 and a walk-out −50.
Tap Antidote's poster on the dining room wall for +250 the first time each run, and you can watch his review.

qa.q: What are Adult and Kid mode?
qa.a: Adult is regular speed. Kid mode is for ages 12 and under, with slower timers, gentler cooling and kid-sized prizes. Each mode has its own prizes, best score and weekly board.
A parent or guardian (18+) signs in first, then hands over the phone. Kid scores and prizes go on the parent's account. Leaving Kid mode asks for the last 4 digits of the parent's phone.
Score 9,500 for a Free Fresh Squeezed OJ, 11,000 for a Free side of French Friez, 12,750 for Free Sweet Gritz, or 13,250 for a Free Chocolate Chip Waffle.
They're redeemed with the young player at the table, one per kid per visit. Kid prize codes start with KID-.

qa.q: What can adults win in the game?
qa.a: One run over 13,500 wins a Free Kiki Palmer. 22,000 wins a Free side of Smackin' Mac, 32,000 a Free Fried Cheese Gritz, and 46,500 a Free Original Collard Green Dip.
The prizes listed are samples, and the restaurant picks the real ones, so they can change. Prizes depend only on your score, never on chance.

qa.q: How long do I have to use a game prize?
qa.a: 3 days. You can hold one prize at a time.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins the weekly prize. Adult and Kid modes each have their own board. It resets every Monday, and ties go to the score posted first.

qa.q: What does the weekly champion win?
qa.a: A Free Wingz N' Wafflez plus a karaoke shoutout. The champion is crowned at GNW Karaoke on Wednesday.

qa.q: When is the weekly winner picked?
qa.a: The board closes at Sunday close, and the winner is crowned at GNW Karaoke on Wednesday.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use multiple accounts?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified, and so are adult scores entered in Kid mode.
Legal U.S. residents age 13 or older. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission. Employees and their households can play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Where are the official game rules?
qa.a: Tap the Game & daily spin official rules link at the bottom of the app. They're currently marked as a draft.

qa.q: Can I use the app in another language?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the 🌐 language button for English, Español, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, Tagalog, Tiếng Việt, Հայերեն, فارسی, 日本語, ไทย or Русский. Restaurant and game names stay in English.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: Use Add to Home Screen. On iPhone, tap Share then Add to Home Screen. On Android, tap Install or the ⋮ menu then Add to Home screen. There's a 📲 button in the game menu and the page footer.
I don't have wallet card info. You can add the app to your Home Screen for one-tap rewards.

Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold. Opt-in texts and emails can be stopped anytime by replying STOP or unsubscribing.

qa.q: Do you collect data from kids?
qa.a: No data is collected from children. A parent signs in with their own info, and the child never enters anything. An optional nickname stays on that phone only.

qa.q: Do I have to give my info to play?
qa.a: No. You can play right away. You're asked for your info only when you want to save a score or claim a prize.
An account needs your name, phone number and email, and it's tied to the phone it was made on. The live app confirms your number with a text code.
